title: Detailed crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFE789'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#E8A81C'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFCF4D'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#C98A0E'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- base band -->
  <rect x='12' y='70' width='76' height='16' rx='3' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='12' y='70' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFF2B8'/>
  <rect x='12' y='82' width='76' height='4' rx='2' fill='#B87A08'/>
  <!-- band gems -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='78' r='4.2' fill='#F04A6B'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76.8' r='1.4' fill='#FFC2CE'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='4.2' fill='#3FB6E8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76.8' r='1.4' fill='#CDEFFF'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='4.2' fill='#F04A6B'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='76.8' r='1.4' fill='#FFC2CE'/>

  <!-- upper crown body -->
  <path d='M12 70 L12 40 L28 58 L42 26 L50 46 L58 26 L72 58 L88 40 L88 70 Z' fill='url(#gold2)'/>

  <!-- decorative ridge line -->
  <path d='M12 62 L28 62 L42 50 L50 58 L58 50 L72 62 L88 62' fill='none' stroke='#FFF2B8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- side flourish gems -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='56' r='3' fill='#8CE07A'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='56' r='3' fill='#8CE07A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='3.2' fill='#B47CE8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='1.2' fill='#EBD6FF'/>

  <!-- points with orbs -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#F04A6B'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='36.8' r='1.6' fill='#FFC2CE'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='56' r='0' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='24' r='4.5' fill='#3FB6E8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='22.8' r='1.6' fill='#CDEFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#FFD24D'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='24' r='4.5' fill='#3FB6E8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='22.8' r='1.6' fill='#CDEFFF'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#F04A6B'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='36.8' r='1.6' fill='#FFC2CE'/>

  <!-- little spikes between points -->
  <path d='M20 70 L20 54 L24 60 Z' fill='#FFE789'/>
  <path d='M80 70 L80 54 L76 60 Z' fill='#FFE789'/>

  <!-- center top cross ornament -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='30' width='3' height='12' rx='1.4' fill='#FFF2B8'/>
  <rect x='45' y='33.5' width='10' height='3' rx='1.4' fill='#FFF2B8'/>
</svg>
